review_candidates.title: Principal Product Manager
review_candidates.description: Join Thoughtworks at the beginning of our next chapter in the Middle East. KSA and the UAE are strategic growth markets for us, fueled by ambitious national agendas around AI, digital government, data, and economic transformation, such as Vision 2030. We are looking for an experienced Product Leader to join our fast-growing local team in Riyadh. This isn't about joining a large, established operation; this is a chance to shape something from the beginning. In this founding phase, you will have the genuine opportunity to help build our teams, propositions, culture, and client relationships from an early stage, all backed by Thoughtworks' global depth in product, design, engineering, data, and AI. As a trusted advisor to senior client leadership, you will partner with ambitious executives and entrepreneurial founders to convert bold visions into market-ready, production-grade products and experiences at pace. Operating at the intersection of business strategy, human-centered design, and emerging technology, you will lead fast-paced, multidisciplinary lean AI-first pods for clients and activate business growth through consultative pre-sales and account expansion in high-growth markets. You will champion the 333 methodology, our rapid delivery framework to accelerate product concepting, validation, and build cycles. Job Responsibilities Partner directly with C-suite and founder-level stakeholders to navigate high-stakes, rapid builds. Manage complex expectations, align diverse workstreams, and frame technical trade-offs around tangible business outcomes. Drive a relentless innovation mindset across the full product lifecycle. Move ambitious ideas past the "pilot trap" into production systems that deliver tangible business ROI - rigorously balancing user Desirability, technical Feasibility, and economic Viability. Establish the market and competitive landscape, go-to-market strategy, and business case or economic model for unprecedented client opportunities. Lead modern product development practices within autonomous, cross-functional pods (Product, Design, Engineering), integrating AI across the entire product lifecycle - from accelerated discovery and research to AI-first delivery. Provide hands-on leadership within lean pods to drive multidisciplinary teams towards high-impact outcomes. Lead large, complex programmes across multiple workstreams and stakeholder groups, owning strategy, roadmap, scope, and outcomes end to end. Lead growth initiatives by shaping client engagements, authoring high-impact proposals, delivering executive pitches, and running strategic discovery workshops that establish a trusted advisory footprint. Own and contribute to account growth targets, identifying opportunities to expand existing client relationships into new engagements and revenue streams in this strategic growth market. Play a foundational role in scaling local organisational capabilities, fostering an inclusive culture, and authoring case studies, points of view (POVs), and repeatable frameworks that adapt global tech expertise to regional market needs. Job Qualifications Technical skills 8+ years of product leadership driving new product launches, commercialisation, and production-scale growth of digital products and platforms, including building and leading high-performing, multidisciplinary product organisations. End-to-end expertise launching net-new products to market - navigating discovery, framing value propositions, leading rapid cross-functional pods, driving go-to-market strategies, and establishing monetisation models to achieve product-market fit before scaling. Depth in conducting research and leveraging market trends, customer insights, and competitive intelligence to facilitate strategic ideation and identify opportunities for growth. Expertise in developing value propositions for digital and AI products, using lean, innovative approaches to test viability, feasibility, and desirability. Deep commercial acumen spanning pre-sales, engagement structuring, unit economics, monetisation strategies, and organic account expansion - connecting technological innovation directly to ROI and business value. Proven ability to operate at company, portfolio, and product levels - defining and executing strategy, shaping a vision, and translating it into a roadmap with clear, value-based measures of success. Ability to advise clients on becoming a value-driven, customer-centric product organisation and drive change by introducing best practices in product management, value delivery, and measurement. Fluency in leveraging AI tools and platforms to transform the end-to-end product development lifecycle - accelerating market research, user discovery, prototyping, spec generation, automated testing, and performance analytics. Professional Skills Skilled at operating and building relationships with C-suite executives, with the confidence to drive conversations at the intersection of technology, product, business, and transformation. Experience with consultative selling and senior client leadership - diagnosing client needs, co-creating solutions, and building trusted-advisor relationships that convert into long-term engagements rather than transactional sales. Exceptional storytelling, negotiation, and workshop facilitation skills, with a proven track record of guiding demanding executive stakeholders and entrepreneurial clients through rapid, ambiguous builds. Passionate about being a visible external voice for the practice - speaking at conferences and contributing to industry panels or publications to build our brand presence in the Middle East. A builder mindset with a strong inclination to work collaboratively alongside multidisciplinary teams, leading by example. A curious, open mindset that challenges established ways of working, energised by helping build a new Thoughtworks business from an early stage and reimagining the product development lifecycle for a faster-paced, AI-enabled era. Other Things To Know Working Model Hybrid – 3 days on-site/week L&D There's no one-size-fits-all career path at Thoughtworks: however you want to develop your career is entirely up to you. But we also balance autonomy with the strength of our cultivation culture. This means your career is supported by interactive tools, numerous development programs and teammates who want to help you grow. We see value in helping each other be our best and that extends to empowering our employees in their career journeys. Benefits We offer amazing benefits from the day you start including private medical insurance, travel insurance, income protection, critical illness, life assurance, pension scheme, personal development budget, 25 days holiday and a ride2work scheme. (Note: These can be adjusted to match exact KSA regional benefits if required). DE&I We proudly, passionately and actively strive to make both Thoughtworks and our industry more representative of the communities we serve. We promote diversity in all its forms and reject discrimination and inequality. Our diversity and award-winning culture inspires our thought leaders and serves to nurture and develop amazing ideas. We believe this makes us a world-leading destination of choice for all technologists. About Thoughtworks Thoughtworks is a global technology consultancy that integrates strategy, design and engineering to drive digital innovation. For 28+ years, our clients have trusted our autonomous teams to build solutions that look past the obvious. Here, computer science grads come together with seasoned technologists, self-taught developers, midlife career changers and more to learn from and challenge each other. Join Thoughtworks at the beginning of our next chapter in the Middle East. You'll have the opportunity to work on ambitious AI, data, and digital transformation challenges, while helping build our teams, culture, and business in one of the world's fastest-moving technology markets. Together, our extra curiosity, innovation, passion and dedication overcomes ordinary. See here our AI policy.

review_candidates.title: Principal Geotechnical Engineer
review_candidates.description: ECS is hiring a Principal Geotechnical Engineer to join our team in Atlanta, GA! As a Principal Geotechnical Engineer with ECS you will provides technical leadership for major projects across multiple sectors - public infrastructure, commercial, industrial, mission critical/data center and much more. Combining technical excellence with mentorship and business development. You will lead a multidisciplinary team of field staff, engineers, and scientists while serving as a primary technical authority for the region. Key Responsibilities Serve as the final technical reviewer and signatory for geotechnical reports, designs, plans and analysis. Ensuring 100% accuracy of designs and project deliverables. Oversee the development of geotechnical engineering reports and design packages, providing technical seal and signature as the Engineer of Record. Provide technical expertise for geotechnical staff across the branch and region, focusing on various local, regional, and state regulations. Mentor junior and mid-level engineers, technicians, designers, and project managers to support professional growth and internal promotion. Lead complex engineering designs for slope stability, shallow and deep foundations, retaining structures, and settlement evaluations. Direct project managers on field exploration activities, including drilling, test pits, and site inspections. Drive business development by attending client meetings and identifying growth opportunities to expand our transportation portfolio. Collaborate with the Associate Principal review committee to identify and mentor future leadership candidates. Basic Qualifications 12 or more years of experience in geotechnical and transportation engineering. Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Civil Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, Geological Engineering, or a related field. Professional Engineer (PE) license is required; Professional Geologist (PG) license may be acceptable depending on state requirements. Documented expertise in DOT Geotechnical Design Manual (GDM) and AASHTO LRFD specifications. Proficiency in MicroStation, OpenRoads or similar programs for infrastructure and highway design projects. Proven track record of serving as a senior technical reviewer at a previous engineering firm. Valid driver’s license for travel to project sites and client meetings. Preferred Qualifications Utilize specialized software including gINT, LPile, APile, MSEW, FB-Pier, and GRLWEAP to deliver innovative design solutions. Experience managing 3 or more large-scale transportation projects simultaneously. Active participation in industry organizations such as ASCE, ACEC, or specialized geotechnical institutes. ECS Group of Companies (ECS) was founded in 1988 with the goal to raise the standards of professional engineering consulting. Today, we are a leader in geotechnical, construction materials, environmental and building science + infrastructure consulting services. We are employee-owned with more than 3,00 employees in 100+ offices and testing facilities coast to coast. ECS is currently ranked #60 in Engineering News-Record’s Top 500 Design Firms (April 2026), #148 in Engineering News-Record’s Top 200 Environmental Firms (October 2025) and #38 in Zweig Group’s Hot Firm List (June 2026). Own operational performance, service quality, compliance and employee experience across the region. Ensure payroll processes comply with all legislative, tax and regulatory requirements. Oversee relationships with payroll vendors and service providers, ensuring contractual service levels are achieved. Monitor operational KPIs and implement actions to continuously improve performance. Leadership Lead, develop and inspire a geographically dispersed team of payroll professionals. Create a high-performing, inclusive and accountable team culture. Coach leaders and build succession plans to strengthen organisational capability. Foster collaboration across regional and global payroll teams. Risk, Governance & Compliance Ensure robust payroll controls and governance frameworks are embedded across all countries. Lead remediation activities for payroll issues and drive sustainable process improvements. Manage operational, compliance and financial risks, ensuring issues are escalated appropriately. Support internal and external audits and ensure timely closure of audit actions. Stakeholder Management Act as the senior payroll representative for the Americas region. Build trusted relationships with senior stakeholders across HR, Finance, Employment Tax, Engineering and Legal. Present operational performance, risks and strategic initiatives to senior leadership. Partner with Works Councils, employee representatives and regulatory bodies where required. Transformation & Continuous Improvement Lead regional payroll transformation initiatives supporting the Global Payroll strategy. Drive process standardisation, automation and operational efficiency. Champion data quality, reporting and analytics to support informed decision-making. Leverage technology and digital solutions to improve payroll accuracy and employee experience. Experience Significant experience leading large, complex payroll operations within multinational organisations. Extensive expertise managing high-volume United States payroll is essential. Experience overseeing payroll operations across Canada and Latin America is highly desirable. Demonstrated success leading regional or global payroll teams. Strong understanding of payroll governance, controls, compliance and risk management. Experience working with outsourced payroll providers and payroll technology platforms. Proven track record delivering payroll transformation and continuous improvement programmes. Experience managing executive stakeholders and operating within complex matrix organisations. Skills & Competencies Strategic leadership with strong operational execution. Excellent people leadership and coaching capability. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Outstanding stakeholder management and influencing skills. Commercially minded with sound judgement and decision-making ability. Resilient and able to lead effectively through change. Exceptional communication and presentation skills. High levels of integrity, accountability and attention to detail. Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Human Resources, Accounting or a related discipline. Professional payroll qualification (APA, CPP or equivalent) preferred. Lean, Six Sigma or project management qualifications are advantageous. Success Measures Accurate, compliant and timely payroll delivery across all countries. review_candidates.description: Job Highlight This is an exceptional opportunity to contribute to UNOPS' strategic growth and impact across North Africa and the Indian Ocean SIDS. The role offers exposure to high-level partnership development, resource mobilization, and project formulation, allowing for significant professional growth within a leading UN organization focused on sustainable development. Role Purpose The Partnerships Analyst will support and contribute to the development of new projects, partnership development, resource mobilization, and the strategic positioning of UNOPS across the Multi-Country Office countries. The incumbent will play an active role in identifying and developing business opportunities, cultivating relationships with partners and donors, advancing the resource mobilization pipeline, and supporting the Office's strategic positioning with key stakeholders. Functions / Key Results Expected Under the global leadership of the Multi-Country Office Director, and under the direct supervision of the Partnerships and Communication Team Lead, the Partnerships Analyst will support and contribute to the development of new projects, partnership development, resource mobilization and the strategic positioning of UNOPS across the Multi-Country Office countries. The incumbent will play an active role in identifying and developing business opportunities, cultivating relationships with partners and donors, advancing the resource mobilization pipeline, and supporting the Office's strategic positioning with key stakeholders. The incumbent will have strong organizational, analytical and communication skills, a proven ability to work effectively under pressure and in challenging environments, and demonstrated ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with a diverse range of partners and stakeholders. The position will work across the following key focus are: Project Development and Positioning of UNOPS Identify and assess potential project and business opportunities aligned with UNOPS' mandate, strategic priorities and areas of comparative advantage. Analyse development priorities, government programmes, donor strategies, investment priorities and emerging needs to identify opportunities for UNOPS engagement and positioning. Lead, as assigned, the development of expressions of interest, concept notes, capacity statements, proposals, logical frameworks and other project development documents for prospective engagements. Coordinate with internal teams and prospective partners to clarify project requirements, develop project concepts and formulate initial project requests. Develop high-level estimates of project scope, effort and costs and consolidate the technical, financial and contextual information required for project development. Contribute to the positioning of UNOPS as an implementation partner by articulating relevant UNOPS capabilities, operational experience and project management expertise in response to partner priorities. Prepare substantive partner profiles, opportunity assessments, background analyses, briefing notes, talking points and presentations for project development discussions, strategic meetings and missions. Participate in discussions with prospective partners and stakeholders and ensure systematic follow-up of opportunities, commitments and agreed next steps. Maintain and analyse information on prospective projects, opportunities and partner intelligence to support the development and prioritization of the project pipeline. Partnerships and Resource Mobilization Identify, map and assess funding and partnership opportunities with governments, UN entities, bilateral and multilateral donors, international financial institutions, multilateral development banks, foundations, NGOs, civil society and the private sector. Contribute substantively to the implementation of the Multi-Country Office's partnership and resource mobilization priorities, including the identification, qualification and advancement of opportunities through the pipeline. Develop and maintain a structured overview of key partners, donor priorities, funding cycles, funding mechanisms, partnership modalities and emerging funding opportunities. Build and maintain effective working relationships with existing and prospective partners and support targeted engagement based on identified opportunities and shared priorities. Prepare and coordinate substantive inputs for donor and partner meetings, strategic missions, consultations and other resource mobilization activities. Coordinate the development and follow-up of partnership opportunities from initial identification through project formulation and, where relevant, engagement approval. Support the negotiation and refinement of project and partnership documentation within the scope of the role and in coordination with relevant internal stakeholders.
